title: Zero-cell counter update
statement: Let $M$ be a finite-state Turing machine with Boolean tape symbols, and let $y,x$ be Boolean words. Choose a bit vector encoding a transition-table selector, a simulated input-head position, and a configuration $c$ of $M$ on $x$. Let the counter tape have contents $\tau_C:\mathbb{Z}\to\mathrm{Option}(\mathrm{Bool})$ and head position $z_C\in\mathbb{Z}$, and let $\tau_O$ and $z_O$ specify the other auxiliary tape. If the counter tape contains the Boolean symbol false at $z_C$, then one step of the tabulating machine changes the simulated configuration to the same decoding state, writes true at $z_C$, and moves the counter head to $z_C+1$, leaving the other specified data unchanged.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean finite Turing machine M
A selector bit vector of length nbits(M)
A position P among y's input-head positions
A configuration c of M on x

Other auxiliary tape contents τO and head position zO
